About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionThis position is part of our Safety Business Unit, which aims to enable safer, greener and more inclusive industries and transportation systemsTasks and responsibilities- Support the establishment of safety analyses for aircraft systems, supporting all the phases during and after certification- Generating and update of assessments (Functional Hazard Assessment/System Safety Assessment) of intended design modifications to influence the system architecture according to the required System Safety/System Integrity- Determine the particular Safety requirements for system developments or modifications with respect to hardware and software- Manage input from and output to interfacing technical domains and technology (processes, maintenance, human error, aircraft performance and quality, etc.)- Review, approval and application of supplier data regarding Safety and Reliability. Generating the System Safety Assessment documentation, based on traceable results and evidence, as mandatory proof to acquire the Type CertificateRequired qualificationThe work task requires knowledge and skills that are usually acquired through a relevant, completed course of study with a standard period of study of up to 4 years in the area of aeronautical engineering, Electrical Engineering or Mechatronics Engineering or equivalant. The overall knowledge and experience required may have been acquired in other waysDesired skills and competences- Knowledge and experience in the above-mentioned areas of responsibility- First experience in the field of System Safety Engineering in the aviation industry- First experience with aircraft systems- Target-oriented with analytic problem-solving skills- Willing to learn new things- Able to perform several Systems Safety tasks in parallel- Team player, organized and autonomous person with good communication skills- Very good written and spoken English and German (B2)- Willingness to travel domestically and internationallyLocationYou will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacyYour advantages- Mobile working and flexible working hours- Fair and attractive remuneration and special payments- 30 days' holiday and additional days off for special occasions- Intensive induction and expert support as part of onboarding in the form of personalized onboarding with a personal mentor- Excellent training opportunities and promising development prospects- Attractive social benefits and offers, including employer-financed pension scheme, employee share options, discounted car leasing, bike leasing, special conditions for insurance, employee benefits at cooperating companies- On-site facilities (depending on location) e. g. canteen and cafeteria, fitness studio, on-site kindergarten, company medical service and other health-related servicesThis activity requires an awareness of possible compliance risks and behavior with integrity. Both points are basic requirements for the success, good reputation and sustainable growth of the companyNot a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutionsTake your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growthBy submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. About UsVirtue Intelligence GmbH is an internationally operating technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, Germany. We specialize in electronic components, semiconductors, Internet of Things (IoT) solutions, industrial networking, and embedded systems.By combining international sourcing capabilities, technical expertise, and strong partnerships with manufacturers and development teams, we provide electronic components and customized technology solutions to customers across Germany and Europe.To support our continued business expansion, we are seeking an experienced and results-driven Technical Sales & Business Development Manager.The primary focus of this role is to develop our electronic components and semiconductor business, while actively expanding our customer base and identifying new opportunities in IoT solutions and industrial networking products.Key Responsibilities1. Sales & Business Development- Identify and acquire new customers across Germany and Europe, particularly OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, system integrators, and industrial manufacturers.- Develop and maintain long-term customer relationships and strategic accounts.- Drive sales of electronic components, including semiconductors, integrated circuits (ICs), active and passive components, connectors, and related products.- Actively develop new customers and business opportunities for IoT devices, embedded systems, and industrial networking solutions.- Promote industrial Ethernet switches, industrial routers, 4G/5G communication devices, asset trackers, sensors, and customized hardware solutions.- Identify potential customers in industrial automation, logistics, telecommunications, smart infrastructure, and other relevant industries.- Manage the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and customer inquiries to quotations, negotiations, and contract closure.- Achieve agreed revenue, gross margin, and business development targets.2. Electronic Components Sales & Customer Support- Manage customer inquiries, Requests for Quotation (RFQs), Bills of Materials (BOMs), and component sourcing requirements.- Prepare competitive quotations and negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, and commercial terms.- Support customers in sourcing hard-to-find, shortage, and end-of-life (EOL) components.- Identify design-in opportunities and provide technical and commercial support during component selection.- Collaborate with international manufacturers, distributors, and supply partners.- Identify cross-selling opportunities and expand business with existing customers.- Support customers throughout the entire purchasing process, from initial inquiry to successful delivery.3. Product Management & Technical Solutions- Support the management and development of selected product portfolios, including electronic components, IoT devices, and industrial networking products.- Identify new products and technologies based on customer requirements, market trends, and business opportunities.- Evaluate manufacturer and partner solutions regarding technical suitability, commercial competitiveness, and market potential.- Support technical discussions, product selection, design-in activities, and customized hardware development.- Define product requirements in collaboration with customers, engineering teams, and development partners.- Contribute to product roadmaps, business cases, pricing strategies, and go-to-market activities.- Support new product introductions and product lifecycle management.4. International Supplier & Project Coordination- Establish and maintain relationships with international manufacturers, distributors, and technology partners.- Coordinate product specifications, pricing, availability, delivery schedules, and technical requirements.- Act as an interface between customers, suppliers, engineering teams, purchasing, and logistics.- Support customer-specific development projects and technical evaluations.- Coordinate IoT and industrial networking projects from initial requirements through product delivery.- Assist in resolving technical, quality-related, and supply chain issues.5. Market Analysis & Strategic Business Development- Monitor market trends, technology developments, pricing, and competitive activities in the electronics industry.- Identify emerging opportunities in electronic components, IoT, and industrial communication markets.- Explore potential new product categories, suppliers, and strategic partnerships.- Develop sales strategies and support go-to-market plans for new products and solutions.- Represent Virtue Intelligence at trade fairs, industry exhibitions, and customer events.- Maintain accurate customer information, sales opportunities, and project records in CRM systems.- Prepare regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and business development reports.Qualifications & RequirementsProfessional Qualifications- Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least three years of professional experience in electronic component sales, semiconductor distribution, technical sales, or business development.- Proven experience in new customer acquisition and B2B relationship development.- Solid knowledge of electronic components, semiconductors, and the electronics supply chain.- Experience working with OEMs, ODMs, EMS providers, electronics manufacturers, or industrial customers.- Familiarity with RFQs, BOM analysis, component sourcing, pricing negotiations, and customer project management.- An established customer network within the German or European electronics industry is highly desirable.- Experience working with electronic component distributors, semiconductor manufacturers, or international technology partners is an advantage.Additional Technical Expertise – Preferred- Knowledge of IoT technologies, embedded systems, or industrial networking.- Familiarity with industrial Ethernet switches, routers, and industrial communication solutions.- Understanding of wireless and cellular technologies, including 4G, 5G, LTE-M, and NB-IoT.- Experience with IoT devices, asset tracking, sensors, or wireless communication modules.- Experience in technical product management, design-in projects, or customized electronic solutions.Experience in IoT and industrial networking is considered a strong advantage but is not mandatory. Proven electronic component sales experience and customer development capabilities remain the primary selection criteria.Personal Skills- Strong sales orientation, commercial awareness, and negotiation skills.- Entrepreneurial mindset with a proactive and results-driven approach.- Ability to work independently and manage multiple customers and projects.- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.- Customer-focused attitude and willingness to develop long-term business partnerships.- Ability to collaborate effectively with international customers, suppliers, and engineering teams.- Willingness to travel for customer meetings, trade shows, and occasional international business trips.Language Requirements- German: Native-level proficiency, both written and spoken.- English: Excellent communication skills, both written and spoken.- Additional Languages: Proficiency in other European languages is considered a strong advantage.- Chinese language skills are an advantage but not mandatory.What We Offer- A challenging and rewarding role combining technical sales, business development, and product management.- The opportunity to expand our electronic components business and develop new markets for IoT and industrial networking solutions.- An international business environment with access to manufacturers, suppliers, and technology partners.- Direct collaboration with company management and short decision-making processes.- A high degree of autonomy and the opportunity to shape new business activities.- Flexible working arrangements and remote work options by agreement.- Competitive base salary with performance-based incentives, subject to agreement.- Long-term professional development opportunities and potential for expanded responsibilities.How to ApplyAre you an experienced sales professional in the electronics industry with strong customer relationships and a passion for developing new business opportunities? Would you like to combine your expertise in electronic components with innovative IoT and industrial networking technologies? Join Virtue Intelligence GmbH and help us expand our business across Germany and Europe.Please submit your CV, earliest possible starting date, and salary expectations to:Virtue Intelligence GmbHDarmstadt, GermanyEmail: web@virtue-intelligence.deWebsite: https://virtue-intelligence.com/Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Produktmanagement, Reklamationsbearbeitung, E-Commerce, E-BusinessExpertenkenntnisse: Pre-Sales-ServiceZwingend erforderlich: Präsentation, Außendienst, Vertrieb

jobs.occupation: Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) (Büroassistent/in)
jobs.description: Join our Community of SolversWe are looking for a Expert SAP S/4HANA Cloud Environment Engineer (f/m/d) to join our Business Services (https://jobs.pwc.de/de/de/interne-dienstleistungsbereiche)  division starting from March 2026.Your responsibilitiesResponsibility – As a part of the Product & Technology team, you will deploy and configure SAP BTP services. You will cooperate with business analysts, developers, and deployment teams to prevent and resolve technical issues, ensuring integration and optimization across platforms.Automation - You support the automation tools from SAP BTP (e.g. Build Process Automation) and drive continuous improvement with additional suitable tools. You implement security measures, ensure compliance, and engage stakeholders with clear, focused communication.Solutions – You define guidelines, standards, and manage infrastructure to deliver and maintain SAP S/4HANA-based processes and solutions, ensuring end-to-end integration and optimization within the cloud environment.Innovations – You assess emerging cloud technologies, evaluate SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and SAP BTP innovations, and drive continuous improvement by leveraging tools for automation and efficiency.Your profile- You have completed your studies in computer science, economics, or a comparable field.- You bring several years of experience in SAP BTP management and SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud integrations.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or Ansible.- You have in-depth knowledge of modern technologies such as cloud management platforms, especially SAP Business Technology Platform- You have extensive experience in configuring and optimizing SAP BTP to SAP S/4HANA integrations.- You are fluent in English and German both spoken and written.- Your analytical, independent, and structured approach to work supports you defining guidelines. Furthermore, your communication enables effective collaboration with various teams.Your benefitsFlexibility – We encourage you to choose your working hours and your working place the way that suits you and your lifestyle. We do not have core working hours and we also offer you the possibility of home office or temporary work from abroad. Always in accordance with operational requirements and labor law regulations. Career Development – We are passionate about your personal and professional development, therefore we offer your regular training with our internal Academy, international experiences by doing a secondment and continuous mentoring on the job. Also, we support you on finding suitable external trainings and further education programmes. Lifestyle – You can accumulate overtime on your annual working time account (JAZ) and compensate for it with time off after busy periods. Any remaining overtime is paid out once a year. You also have 30 days of vacation per calendar year.Health and Wellbeing – Your health is important to us: in addition to our own company health insurance scheme, we also offer preventive medical check-ups and divers sport offerings. Take part in our free company sports programme or benefit from reduced rates at various gyms or an Urban Sports Club membership.And there is even more – It is our purpose to create a positive working environment: An environment where flexible and creative working is possible, where work is recognized and performance is rewarded and of which we are all very proud. You can find more detailed information on all of our benefits on our career website.At PwC Germany, it is our purpose to solve our clients' key challenges, create sustainable outcomes and build trust in business and society. As part of our internal IT team (Products & Technology), you are the driver behind our promise: human-led and tech-powered. We are experts for our technology solutions and make the use of technology easier and more efficient. As a team, we develop innovative solutions for the entire product life cycle and manage the use of technology in the organization. Drive the technological development of PwC Germany in our diverse teams!ContactIf you have any questions about this position or your application, please reach out to Patricia Weiss at +49 69 9585-2222.
